Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
Welcome! The best place to start is with our flagship Heavys H1H Headphones.
Engineered specifically for rock and metal by former Sennheiser chief audio engineer Axel Grell, they feature a patented 8-speaker setup (4 drivers in each ear cup), giving you an insanely clear, live-concert soundstage with zero distortion.
They come packed with 50-hour battery life, HellBlocker Active Noise Cancellation, transparency mode, and a bonus travel case. Plus, you can personalize them with swappable artist Shells featuring official band artwork!
